items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: This is the O'Day-Jean Black Diamond Orchestra, 1928... That's Leo Dejean.

ctx.x: This is the O'Day-Jean Black Diamond Orchestra, 1928 the picture says. Can you tell us who the members of that are? That's Eddie Pearson.
Oh, Standing in Back, in the Dark Coat. That's Leo Dejean.
